name: QEMU SeaBIOS + TCG emulated TPM (LapEE test guest)

attributes.measurement_root: SRTM via SeaBIOS ACPI TPM2 table

notes: QEMU's SeaBIOS extends PCR 0 / 1 / 7 with TCG-SeaBIOS's fixed log. Values are stable within a QEMU version but change across QEMU versions. This profile does NOT pin any PCR (match_pcrs is empty) — it is used as documentation that the caller is running in a QEMU test environment, never in production. A real deploy should either refuse QEMU-shaped attestations or require a separate test-only trust anchor.
